semiconductor_relevance: High — MPI Corporation is a global technology leader in semiconductor testing and offers a wide range of advanced equipment and systems for the semiconductor industry.
summary: MPI Corporation specializes in the testing of semiconductors and related technologies, providing advanced probe card technologies, inspection systems, and thermal test systems. Their diverse product portfolio is complemented by state-of-the-art calibration and test & measurement software, catering to various sectors including aerospace and automotive.
capabilities: Mass production and engineering probe systems

regional_presence.Taiwan: Headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan, MPI Corporation operates as a global leader in semiconductor testing.
